scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --packages external --splitting && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json README.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json README.md
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run build
